description:
get: the channel style: its references, its fields (art_style,
narrative_style, director_style, text_style, any added; script_prompt on
request), the summary analysis wrote for each, and templates, the
character and environment template images (null: not rendered; a URL:
it exists, so view_image it rather than render it again).
inputs_stale: the references changed since the last analysis (offer
style_generate action=analyze). templates_stale: the art style changed
since the templates were rendered (offer to render them again).

presets: the preset catalog, one list per axis (art_style,
narrative_style, director_style), with labels, descriptions and, for art
presets, preview images. Let the user pick one per axis.

action.description: get: the channel style (channel_id or project_id); presets: the preset catalog

name: style_read
title: Read the channel style
